tutorial.lesson1Body: Place five vessels within the 10×10 sector without overlap. Their coordinates are never sent to the opponent.
tutorial.lesson2Body: Unattacked cells always remain unknown. Enemy vessel shapes and remaining placements are never revealed in advance.
tutorial.lesson3Title: Designate a coordinate and fire once
tutorial.lesson3Body: Attack one cell each turn. The server decides hits, misses, and sinks, then delivers them to both commanders in the same order.
tutorial.lesson4Title: Manage turn time as an operational resource
tutorial.lesson4Body: The turn advances automatically when time expires. Three consecutive timeouts cause defeat, so monitor both the clock and its warnings.
tutorial.lesson5Body: The server provides a grace period during brief outages. Refreshing restores the same room and turn, while duplicate commands run only once.
